name: RingCentral
desc: Cloud business communications: send SMS, place calls, manage messages, and post to Team Messaging.

actions.name: send_sms
actions.description: Send an SMS text message from one of your RingCentral numbers.

actions.name: make_call
actions.description: Start a two-legged RingOut call: RingCentral calls the "from" number first, then connects it to the "to" number.

actions.name: send_team_message
actions.description: Post a message to a RingCentral Team Messaging chat, group, or team.

actions.name: get_call_log
actions.description: Retrieve call log records for the authenticated user's extension.

actions.name: get_extension_info
actions.description: Get profile information for the authenticated user's extension.

actions.name: get_message
actions.description: Retrieve a single SMS, MMS or voicemail message, including the list of attachments it carries.

actions.name: download_message_attachment
actions.description: Download the content of a message attachment, such as an MMS photo or a voicemail recording, and return it as a file.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_inbound_sms
triggers.description: Triggers when a new inbound text message is received, with or without media attached.

triggers.name: new_voicemail
triggers.description: Triggers when a new voicemail message is received.

triggers.name: new_team_message
triggers.description: Triggers when a new post is added in RingCentral Team Messaging.
